name: Lake Falathim
summary: At Lake Falathim, murlocs now overrun the western Ashenvale shore southwest of Maestra's Post. Night elves once came here to swim and fish, drawn by Elune's moonlight said to touch the water day and night.

sections.title: Bathed in Moonlight
sections.body: Lake Falathim lies southeast of the Zoram Strand, where the Kaldorei once swam and fished in peace. Local lore says Elune's gentle light rests on the water at every hour, by day and by night. Now ferocious murlocs have surged inland and seized the shores. Their numbers drive away travelers and scholars.

sections.title: The Scholar's Disappearance
sections.body: Murlocs have made Lake Falathim dangerous for anyone wandering alone. The night elf scholar Teronis recently went missing near the water while pursuing his inquiry. Sentinels fear for anyone who approaches the moonlit pool alone, with hostile murlocs lurking along the banks and in the shallows.

faq.answer: Lake Falathim lies in western Ashenvale, in the hills southwest of Maestra's Post and southeast of the Zoram Strand.

faq.q: Why is Lake Falathim special to the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves value Lake Falathim because Elune's moonlight is said to touch its waters by day and night. They once came to its peaceful banks to swim and fish.
Hostile murlocs have overrun Lake Falathim's shores, making them dangerous for travelers.
Teronis was a night elf scholar who went missing near Lake Falathim. The vicious murlocs in the area are blamed for his disappearance.

angles.text: As Kaldorei, you know Lake Falathim as a sanctuary touched by Elune's moonlight. Murlocs now threaten its shores.
From Maestra's Post, Alliance scouts watch for murlocs near Lake Falathim and seek word of missing scholars such as Teronis.
